title: Light Zesty Australian Buckwheat Bake
description: A deliciously light Australian buckwheat bake featuring a sweet and tangy jammy center, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: 1 cup buckwheat flour
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a high-quality buckwheat flour

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup almond milk
ingredients.notes: use a non-dairy milk to keep the dish Whole30 compliant

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup coconut oil
ingredients.notes: melted coconut oil adds a rich flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: 2 large eggs
ingredients.notes: fresh eggs are essential for a light and fluffy texture

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup mixed berries
ingredients.notes: fresh or frozen berries work equally well in this recipe

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons honey
ingredients.notes: adjust to taste for desired level of sweetness

ingredients.name: 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality vanilla extract for the best flavor

ingredients.name: 1/4 teaspoon salt
ingredients.notes: a pinch of salt enhances the flavors in the dish

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a 9x9 inch baking dish with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the buckwheat flour, almond milk, melted coconut oil, eggs, mixed berries, honey, vanilla extract, and salt until well combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden and the center is set.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
